name: orca-web
description: Phone-friendly web view for a desktop Orca runtime (view projects/tasks, reply, create, cancel)

scripts.tc: npm run tc:server && npm run web:typecheck
scripts.bundle: node scripts/check-admin-page.mjs && esbuild apps/server/src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist-server/orca-server.cjs && esbuild apps/gateway/src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist-server/orca-gateway.cjs
scripts.release: npm run bundle && npm run web:build
